description: Advisory guidelines for AI-written test files — flags common AI blind spots: sandbox/production parity gaps, error state cleanup omissions, and optimistic rollback assumptions. All rules are severity: info.

sandbox-parity.description: Advisory checks for sandbox vs production environment parity in tests

rules.description: Tests using hardcoded localhost URLs may not reflect production behavior
rules.message: Advisory: hardcoded localhost URL in test — verify this matches your CI/production service discovery pattern

error-cleanup.description: Advisory checks for error state cleanup in tests

rules.description: Tests that create resources should verify cleanup on error paths
rules.message: Advisory: test has setup — confirm teardown/cleanup runs on both success and failure paths

rollback.description: Advisory checks for optimistic rollback assumptions in tests

rules.description: Tests that mock DB transactions may not reflect actual rollback behavior
rules.message: Advisory: mocked rollback may diverge from actual DB behavior — consider an integration test with a real transaction
